newsitem.title: INDIA: India metals' prices steady, industrial buying low.
newsitem.headline: India metals' prices steady, industrial buying low.

text.p: Indian metals held steady on Tuesday as industrial buying remained low but limited arrivals calmed sentiment, dealers said.
"Trading volume was low as major players are out of town owing to the Christmas holidays," one broker said.

Ready copper was steady at 12,350 rupees, zinc at 6,400 and lead at 4,450 rupees. Nickel was quiet at 36,500 rupees and tin at 34,300 rupees amid nominal trading. Aluminium was available at the previous level of 7,250 rupees per quintal.
